limits: No real remote service, paid model invocation or model capability evaluation was performed.
Runner context admission was explicitly stubbed to isolate new runtime; real definition admission integration must be verified separately.
Actual reporter/outbox/SQLite executed; all data and host credentials were isolated synthetic fixtures.
Adapter tests replaced urllib opener with a synthetic transport, so TLS/proxy/network behavior is not claimed.
Local correctness and worker serialization do not establish enterprise concurrency or IAM assurance.
No claim that all Codex/engine conversations are automatically observed.

metadata_delta_review.scope: Only capability/deployment metadata corrected; local trusted runtime distinguished from enterprise/external deployment; prior runtime tests remain applicable.
